description: This file defines a Logger class that manages logging messages (warnings, errors, info) to a specified log file, creating the directory if necessary and providing methods to log messages, write them to the file, and close the file.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A class that handles categorizing and writing log messages to a file. It initializes with a log file path, creates directories if needed, stores messages in lists, and writes them in categorized sections.

methods.name: __init__(self, log_file_path)
methods.description: Initializes the Logger with a log file path, creates necessary directories, opens the log file, and initializes message lists.

methods.name: log(self, level, message)
methods.description: Adds a message to the appropriate message list based on the log level ('WARNING', 'ERROR', 'INFO').

methods.name: write_log(self)
methods.description: Writes all logged messages categorized under warnings, errors, and info to the log file.
